tools.name: diff_text
tools.description: Compare text a with text b by lines (default), words or chars. Returns ops (equal/insert/delete), a unified diff (lines mode), optional escaped HTML redline, stats and similarity. Deterministic diff (Myers algorithm via jsdiff), not an AI or semantic comparison. Limits per side: lines mode 64 KB and

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a single-file unified diff (patch) to text and return the patched text, or applied:false if a hunk does not match. Optional fuzz 0-2.

tools.name: text_similarity
tools.description: Similarity ratio 0-1 between two texts (2 x unchanged chars / total chars) on chars (default), words or lines granularity, plus change stats.
